description.detail: The downloader completed a manifest for pharos319 with counts for every normalised file and a SHA-256 digest per file, so the extract is reproducible byte-for-byte. Ligand activities are capped at 10,000 rows by the API's listCross response rather than by a sampling choice. Diseases keep MONDO, DOID, MESH, UMLS and name-derived keys, and genes carry HGNC identifiers.
description.numbers: 635 targets, 603 genes, 603 translations, 1919 diseases, 11568 target_disease, 3294 ligands, 10000 ligand_activity, 2703 ppi, 3061 go_terms, 12823 go_annotation
